subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Start in Chongqing, then travel to Qianjiang and Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on a waterfall. Continue to Zhangjiajie for the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge, a skiing experience at Qixing Mountain and Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, the “Avatar” scenery. You fly Air China round trip and stay in local 5-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 30–Jan 5 2026 to Jan 10–16 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Chongqing
items: Fly Manila to Chongqing (CA482, 02:25–06:20) and meet your guide at the airport

itinerary.title: Chongqing – Qianjiang – Furong

Furong Town, the ancient town hanging on the waterfall (battery bus included)

Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Furong – Zhangjiajie

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Qixing Mountain skiing

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar)
items: Tea tasting at a tea shop or silk shop visit

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Qianjiang

Transfer to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Qianjiang – Chongqing – Manila
items: Transfer to the airport and fly Chongqing to Manila (CA481, 21:30–01:20+1)

placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing monorail station where the train runs through a residential building.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the street-level entrance feels like the first floor but is actually the 22nd.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping area of Chongqing, built around the Liberation Monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A Chongqing street of local hotpot and snacks, where you enjoy food on your own.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A multi-level riverside stilt-house complex in Chongqing, famous for its glowing night view.
placeDesc.Qianjiang Wind & Rain Bridge: A traditional covered wooden bridge in Qianjiang in the style of the local Tujia and Miao peoples.
placeDesc.Furong Town: An ancient Tujia town built on a cliff beside a large waterfall; a battery bus is included.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass bridge over a deep canyon in the Zhangjiajie region, with a VR experience included.
placeDesc.Qixing Mountain: A mountain scenic area near Zhangjiajie, reached by battery car, with viewing platforms and a skiing experience.
placeDesc.1520 Platform: A viewing platform in Qixing Mountain Scenic Area with views over the surrounding mountains.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie National Forest Park: A famous park of tall sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains in the movie Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the park.
placeDesc.No. 1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge between two cliffs inside Zhangjiajie National Forest Park.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The sandstone pillar in the park that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in Avatar.
placeDesc.Tianzi Mountain: A high peak in the Zhangjiajie area known for its forest of rock pillars and mountain views.
placeDesc.Huanglong Cave: A large limestone cave near Zhangjiajie with an underground river; offered as an optional tour with boat ride.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie with a long cable car, a glass skywalk and the natural arch of Tianmen Cave.
placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A restored old river town in Chongqing with stone streets, teahouses and local snacks.
